name: us-bills
title: US bills and resolutions with their official summaries, 116th to 119th Congress

licence.name: US Government work, no copyright
licence.source_statement: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.
licence.statement_seen_in: the dublinCore dc:rights element of every BILLSUM and BILLS XML file

source.robots_note: Disallows /core/, /profiles/, /search/, /admin/ and the user paths. Says nothing about /bulkdata/.

exclude.why: private relief bills name a living person; personal data is out on docs/42 §5. The rule runs on every measure type, not just hr and s

schema.name: type
schema.note: hr, s, hres, sres, hjres, sjres, hconres or sconres

schema.name: version_code
schema.note: the summary's version suffix, e.g. v00. With bill_id this is the row key

schema.name: summary_text
schema.note: HTML stripped, paragraphs kept as blank-line breaks

schema.name: summary
schema.note: alias of summary_text, so FiscalNote/billsum code runs unchanged

schema.name: text
schema.note: bill text of the version the summary describes, else the latest available

schema.name: text_version_code
schema.note: govinfo bill version, e.g. ih, eh, es, enr

schema.name: text_match
schema.note: action if the version was chosen from the summary's action, latest if it fell back, none if no text was found

schema.name: retrieved_at
schema.note: UTC, when the source bytes were fetched

schema.name: sha256
schema.note: sha256 of the summary source bytes, then of the text source bytes, space separated

not_covered: Congresses before the 116th. FiscalNote/billsum covers the 103rd to the 115th, and California bills, which this library does not.
Private relief bills, excluded on the rule above. The rule runs on every measure type.
Measures with no official summary. govinfo publishes a summary only once CRS writes one, so a bill or resolution without one has no row here.
Amendments, treaties, conference reports and nominations. The eight measure types covered are hr, s, hres, sres, hjres, sjres, hconres and sconres.
